Final Round Part 1:

30 min - Interview with VP of Customer Success

30 min - Cross-functional Leadership interview

30 min - Interview with CEO

10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager

You get to sell a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Director of Global Campaigns.

About the job

As the head of the Twilio Global Campaign team, you are responsible for owning, developing and executing the major campaigns that drive awareness and opportunities for Twilio. This role is highly cross functional, working closely with both internal marketing partners across regions, sales, product, and company leadership to design end-to-end campaigns that deliver on business objectives. You possess a proven track record of leading multi-channel global campaigns with success, collaborating with stakeholders, and finding opportunities to strategically uplevel Twilio’s campaign engine. 

The ideal candidate has an advanced understanding of how campaigns resonate with a global audience, not just one country. You are skilled in understanding the modern AI-driven buyer journey at each stage of the funnel, have the ability to translate messaging frameworks into effective campaigns, and thrives in a collaborative environment. You recognize the value of running an integrated campaign motion, and have the ability to think both strategically and execute at an operational level with ease. Your performance will be measured by your ability to execute and achieve measurable results including building brand awareness, developing a system of content and assets that is valuable to all regions, and building campaigns that accelerate growth velocity. 

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

Set a strategic vision for global campaign structure, operations, and execution for our top 5 campaign motions. We are looking for someone who is very strategic in terms of knowing the audience, how to create content that resonates, tactics to reach that audience, and ideas that are visionary and tactical.

Be accountable to company leadership on the effectiveness of all global campaigns and programs

Strong project management skills and ability to use data to guide decision-making and resource allocation. Design and execute strategic end-to-end campaigns that both engage and convert prospective buyers with a focus on specific buyer and vertical segments

Partner with product marketing, content strategists, brand strategists, creative designers and other regional campaign teams to create campaign themes and messaging that translate into impactful marketing campaigns. Act as the central point of contact to direct all campaign work across teams to ensure timely results

Build strong relationships with key cross functional stakeholders across multiple organizations to ensure campaign enablement and engagement 

A global systems approach. Develop scalable, repeatable campaign playbooks that can be scaled quickly with a large variety of content that works in all regions

Track program results, measure program success and report metrics to customer success, sales and marketing stakeholders and executives. Then analyze campaign performance, surface insights and provide recommendations for optimizing results

AI-Driven Enablement: We want you to infuse AI frameworks into all aspects of the campaign model. Ideally you would disrupt the norms and evolve the team and programs to be progressive. And equip teams across the organization with the tools, guidelines, and frameworks to create high-quality content at scale, including standards, reusable templates, and AI-assisted workflows that improve consistency, speed, and quality.

Budget Management: Manage and allocate budget for campaign production resources across all campaign and persona needs, including original content, video production, localization, and agencies to ensure efficient and high-quality execution and return on investment

Global team leadership: Manage a team with a global remit that spans all regions from the US to Europe to Asia, while working with company and brand leadership to execute all top-of-funnel campaigns.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

Management experience: ability to inspire a team of strategists and show a vision of what is possible and where our teams should focus efforts

Deep understanding of marketing funnel tactics and metrics by stage, PLG model and funnel 

Understanding of enterprise buying cycles, sales processes and stakeholders, especially in B2B tech

Self-starter who excels in a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative high-growth environment

Ability to manage multiple work streams and has presence with the team and leadership

Strategic thinker with strong attention to detail

8+ years working as a campagin strategist in B2B or tech

Proven experience building and delivering on integrated programs and managing all tools, processes, and assets

Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to drive alignment, set expectations and drive to success

Works well with cross-functional teams and executives, to ensure consistent content is delivered across the company

A champion for fostering a culture of trust through feedback, communication, and transparency

Desired:

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organization.

Familiarity with localization tactics to ensure our content is accessible and inclusive across multiple countries.

Experience with primary research strategies and types of content creation

Strategic ability to see opportunities across campaigns and programs where new types of content and programs will thrive.

Experience building world-class brands through premium content

Experience with a variety of AI, design, analytics, and video tools. Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms such as Tableau, Salesforce, AEM, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Canva

Location

This role will be remote based in Ireland or the UK

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Deal Desk team partners closely with our Sales organisation to drive market wins and achieve our revenue targets. As the Deal Desk Analyst supporting EMEA Mid-Market, you'll drive commercial outcomes for the region, applying deal economics and policy judgment to help Sales structure terms that win deals and protect Samsara's revenue. You'll work closely with Sales, Legal, and Finance leadership across the region, and you'll be the person Sales calls when a deal needs a fast, well-reasoned answer.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

You bring clarity to high-stakes conversations: You're comfortable telling a seller no and keeping them on your side — and just as ready to get on a live customer call when a deal needs a clear, confident voice in the room.

You live at the intersection of sales and finance: You can look at a discount, a payment schedule and know exactly what it means for Samsara's revenue — and you want to be the one making that call, deal by deal.

In this role, you will: 

Own deal economics for the EMEA Mid-Market portfolio and know when a deal sits within your approval authority versus when it needs to escalate

Sign off on certain non-standard terms within your own financial parameters, backed by your own authority rather than a case-by-case Legal review

Manage the EMEA Mid-Market deal desk end-to-end — hold Sales to policy on discount and payment terms, help shape the SLAs and triage rules that keep a high-volume pipeline moving using AI tools to drive efficiency

Partner with Sales to solve for non-standard requests — while maintaining a partnership mindset

Protect quarter-end metrics anchoring deals on annual terms early and applying your team's escalation framework consistently

Own final approval for your segment, and coach Sales on the thresholds so they flag you before a deal needs you

Partner with Legal, Sales and Customers directly when a deal needs Deal Desk's voice in the room

Collaborate with Sales Enablement to keep Sales current on policies and thresholds — 1:1s, group sessions, refreshers, and onboarding for new starters

Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

Experience in a comparable role within Deal Desk 

Demonstrated ability to evaluate deal economics against company policy

Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (formulas, modelling) and experience with CRM systems (i.e., Salesforce) and quoting tools 

Proven experience owning a large, high-volume book independently with minimal oversight, and knowing when a deal needs to be escalated

Experience operating in a high-volume queue with frequent, direct pushback from Sales, while maintaining a partnership mindset

Proficient with AI tools (e.g., internal deal-desk AI assistants, CRM copilots) for research, drafting, and speedy deal reviews

Strong communication skills, resilience, and a problem-solving mindset — comfortable being the voice of finance on a live Sales or customer call, and steady under a high volume of pushback

This is a remote first position open to candidates based in the United Kingdom with travel to our London office (1 Alie St, London E1 8DE) as needed. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role

An ideal candidate also:

Has direct, first-hand experience defending a commercial position live with a customer or seller, not just reviewing tickets

Has experience operating in a small, fast-paced, high-ownership environment, and is comfortable being the sole owner of a function end-to-end

Is self-motivated, intellectually curious, and commercially minded 

Builds real partnerships across Sales, Legal, Sales Ops, Credit/Order Management 

Has an appetite for enablement — comfortable training and upskilling a Sales team on policy and deal structuring, not just gatekeeping it

Is comfortable with financial modelling in spreadsheets/CPQ (cash-flow payback, gross margin, blended discount, payment-term impact) and picks up new systems quickly

Proactively identifies and helps resolve internal process or systems friction (e.g., issues with GTM Systems tooling), partnering with the Implementation team to fix it

#LI-Hybrid

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Toptal prides itself on being a data-driven organization. The primary objective of the Data Analytics Engineer is to help drive business impact and better decision making by laying the data foundation for a world-class analytics function. This role will be critical to fostering trust in our data and confidence in our decisions.

Our Data Analytics Engineers focus on creating a data environment that is conducive to analytics and business decision making. You will own and maintain the data transformation layer. This will require data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security), data modeling (structure, relationships, integrity), technical communication (data dictionaries, user training), quality control (code reviews, data validation), raw data analysis, and building AI data systems and pipelines. You will be the product owner for our data warehouse and will coordinate closely with our functional Business Analysts on one side, and Data Engineers on the other.

This role sits within the Business Analytics Center of Excellence and will ensure trustworthy data is available for all downstream data users. Positive relationships with both Data Engineers and Business Analysts will be key, but you must also think independently and bring your own point of view. To be successful in this role you must live and breathe SQL daily and be a critical thinker, problem solver and self-starter.

This role requires an AI-heavy workflow and skillset. We’ve transformed our codebase to be instrumented for agentic development and continue to build our internal AI tooling, and you will be part of this process. Fluency with using LLMs and agentic coding tools is a requirement of this role. The flip side of that is the part machines cannot do: understanding our business and metrics deeply, and making decisions on what matters and what doesn’t in terms of pushing the company’s business objectives forward.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

Design, write, review and ship SQL models across our repositories that transform raw data into usable data products for all organizational stakeholders. Own and maintain the transformation layer.

Proactively work with the Data Engineers to ensure new data sources are added and available, and then modeled and published in our data warehouse.

Proactively monitor the data warehouse and extract insights to identify opportunities to improve data operations, data accuracy and quality, coverage, integrity, structure, and general usability.

Turn ambiguous business asks into modeled data. Run requirements gathering with stakeholders. Establish the grain, surface the edge cases, write down the business rules, and push back when the request would produce a misleading number.

Implement measures and processes to improve data quality, accuracy, coverage, lineage, access and retention across dozens of source production databases.

Own the data dictionary. Write table and column documentation that traces each field to its true origin. This documentation is consumed by AI agents as well as humans, and is an integral part of the semantic layer.

Diagnose and resolve data incidents.

Review your teammates’ code and provide feedback to maintain the hygiene of the data warehouse production environment.

Work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business process owners to empower data-driven decision making.

Enable end users to better use data, understand complexities, nuances, and limitations.

Help make the team faster. Improve the agent playbooks, documentation, and tooling the team uses to work with the warehouse.

In the first week, expect to:

Onboard and integrate into Toptal, and begin learning our history, culture and vision.

Get your environment running end to end: GCP access, BigQuery, the Dataform repositories, and our agentic development tooling.

Shadow the teams whose data you will own to learn the core of Toptal’s operations and capabilities, including Growth, Talent Operations, Enterprise, and SMB.

In the first month, expect to:

Understand the data generated through company operations and activities and where/how that data is stored.

Understand our ETL processes, timing, tools, monitoring, roadmap, and pain points.

Understand our source systems, and where they fit into our business processes.

Start receiving and researching inbound data questions from Business Analysts.

Build your first Dataform pull request independently and start reviewing your teammates’ PRs.

In the first three months, expect to:

Develop a mastery of our core data elements and entities.

Begin standardizing definitions and creating SQL logic to push definitions into the data layer.

Be a first responder for data incidents, diagnosing root cause with evidence and a methodical approach.

Begin documenting data flows, definitions, calculation methodologies, and data elements to continuously build and improve the semantic layer.

In the first six months, expect to:

Contribute architectural ideas that impact our data environment and pipelines. Exercise discretion and independent judgment.

Be an integral part of the analytics team that ensures a world-class data warehouse service to our stakeholders.

In the first year, expect to:

Play a critical part in setting up the Business Analytics Center of Excellence for success.

Be the person the organization trusts about what a number means and whether it can be believed.

Have made the warehouse meaningfully more usable by both analysts and AI agents.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in Engineering or a related technical field.

4+ years of experience in an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or Data Analyst role where you personally shipped production data models.

Expert-level SQL skills and a working knowledge of Python.

Fluency with LLMs and agentic coding tools. You already use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent as part of your daily working practice. You know where they are reliable, where they should not be used, and how to verify their output.

Experience with cloud data warehousing, such as BigQuery or Snowflake.

Good understanding of a modern transformation framework (dbt, Dataform, SQLMesh or similar). You understand dependency graphs, refs, incremental strategies, tests and environment promotion as concepts, not just as commands.

Git fluency. Branching, pull requests, code review, conflict resolution and generally working with a critical production environment.

Strong familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster or Prefect. You can read a DAG, understand its schedule and dependencies, and find out why a task failed.

Process discipline. Jira, ticket hygiene, and code review etiquette. It’s mandatory you understand how to avoid shipping unverified LLM-generated code.

Experience in doing exploratory/raw data analysis, data modeling, and data governance (quality, accuracy, coverage, security, etc.).

Experience translating business logic and objectives into SQL code and linking data and analytics to business strategy and operations to drive real impact.

Familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).

Detail oriented, methodical, and thorough.

Team player who builds strong relationships and collaborates with others.

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex issues in a simple and intuitive way.

Ability to work collaboratively and independently; take ownership of quality, accuracy, and timeliness of deliverables.

You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As Director of Partnerships, you will lead the strategy and growth of Toptal’s global partner ecosystem, turning strategic relationships into measurable revenue, differentiated services, and expanded market opportunity across Toptal’s existing and emerging services, products, and new businesses. Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, AI Services, you will work closely with Sales, Services, Talent, Marketing, and senior leadership to identify, activate, and grow strategic partners. This includes joint go-to-market motions, partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, co-selling, joint solutions, marketplace and reseller opportunities, talent certifications, partnership tiers, executive relationships, and partner-funded programs such as Marketing Development Funds (MDF) and sponsorships.

The successful candidate will combine commercial instincts, partnership strategy, operational discipline, and executive relationship management. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can develop the strategy, put pen to paper, build the plans and materials, work directly on opportunities, and drive execution through measurable business results.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and hands-on partnerships leader with strong commercial instincts, executive communication skills, and experience across partnerships, sales, services, and business operations.

Key responsibilities include:

Drive partnership revenue and pipeline: Build and execute partnership strategies that generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, accelerate sales opportunities, and expand revenue across Toptal’s services, products, and new businesses.

Own strategic partner relationships: Develop joint business plans with priority partners, build executive and field-level relationships, establish shared goals, and lead regular business reviews focused on revenue, pipeline, adoption, and growth.

Build joint GTM and co-sell motions: Turn partnerships into actionable sales motions through joint solutions, account mapping, co-selling, marketplace opportunities, reseller programs, sales enablement, campaigns, and events.

Grow Toptal’s position within partner ecosystems: Drive certifications, specializations, partnership tiers, designations, marketplace listings, and other requirements that increase Toptal’s access, credibility, benefits, and commercial opportunity within each ecosystem.

Secure partner investment: Identify and capture Marketing Development Funds (MDF), sponsorships, enablement funding, event support, sales incentives, and other partner-funded programs that can accelerate growth.

Manage the partnership lifecycle: Own partnerships from identification and business case through contracting, onboarding, launch, activation, growth, and ongoing performance management.

Coordinate cross-functional execution: Work closely with Sales, Services, Talent, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Product, and leadership to ensure partnership commitments are translated into clear owners, deliverables, and measurable outcomes.

Measure portfolio performance: Establish and track KPIs across revenue, pipeline, certifications, tier progression, partner engagement, co-sell activity, and partner investment, while maintaining clear visibility into priorities, blockers, and next steps.

Build scalable partnership operations: Create the processes, tools, documentation, and operating cadence required to manage a growing partner portfolio efficiently without losing speed or accountability.

Stay hands-on in execution: Personally develop partner plans, presentations, applications, business cases, enablement materials, and other work required to move partnerships forward and convert strategy into results.

In the first week, expect to:

Build context on Toptal’s partnership strategy, priority partners, current pipeline, and active initiatives.

Meet key stakeholders across Sales, Services, Talent, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Product, and leadership.

Begin transitioning ownership of priority partner relationships, operating cadences, and near-term opportunities.

In the first month, expect to:

Develop a clear view of the partner portfolio, including revenue opportunity, tier status, certifications, GTM motions, and key gaps.

Take ownership of partnership priorities, partner engagement, pipeline visibility, and cross-functional execution.

Identify immediate opportunities to accelerate co-sell activity, partner-funded programs, certifications, and tier progression.

In the first three months, expect to:

Establish joint business plans and measurable growth priorities for Toptal’s most strategic partners.

Launch or strengthen partner-sourced and partner-influenced GTM motions, including co-selling, account mapping, enablement, marketplace, and joint solution opportunities.

Implement scalable processes and metrics for revenue, pipeline, certifications, tier progression, partner investment, and overall portfolio performance.

In the first six months, expect to:

Demonstrate measurable commercial impact through partnership-driven pipeline, revenue opportunities, partner activation, and stronger ecosystem positioning.

Advance priority partners through certifications, designations, tiers, marketplaces, and other programs that expand Toptal’s commercial opportunity.

Establish a consistent operating rhythm across partner planning, executive engagement, pipeline reviews, GTM execution, and performance management.

In the first year, expect to:

Build a scalable partnerships function that is a meaningful contributor to Toptal’s revenue growth and go-to-market strategy.

Develop a portfolio of strategic partners with clear joint business plans, measurable pipeline and revenue impact, stronger partner tiers, and active co-sell motions.

Create the systems, relationships, and operating model required to continue expanding Toptal’s partner ecosystem across existing and emerging services, products, and new businesses.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree is required.

8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, alliances, business development, professional services, sales, or related commercial roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex partner relationships.

Proven experience developing and executing partnership strategies that have contributed to pipeline, revenue growth, co-sell activity, joint solutions, or market expansion.

Experience working with technology, platform, cloud, AI, software, marketplace, or professional services partners is strongly preferred.

Demonstrated ability to build relationships across both executive and field organizations and translate those relationships into actionable joint business plans.

Experience navigating partner programs, including certifications, specializations, tiers, marketplaces, reseller or co-sell programs, MDF, and partner-funded initiatives.

Strong commercial instincts and the ability to identify where a partnership can create meaningful value for both Toptal and the partner.

Proven ability to operate at both the strategic and hands-on executional levels, including developing plans, presentations, business cases, partner applications, and GTM materials.

Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to drive execution across Sales, Services, Talent, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Product, and Operations without relying on direct authority.

Excellent executive communication, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Experience using CRM, pipeline management, analytics, and collaboration tools such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, Slack, and AI productivity tools.

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

jobs.description:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Vice President, Sales – Public, Fleet & Auto

What You Will Be Doing

This role owns two connected functions: strategic account management for a portfolio of top-tier public charging accounts (quota carrying), and segment blueprint creation — structured, evidence-based playbooks for each priority public charging segment (CPOs of all types & Retail and Destination) that capture customer economics, procurement behavior, technical requirements, and competitive dynamics. The blueprints are not a static reference document — they are the primary mechanism for feeding validated, field-tested segment intelligence into Product, Policy, R&D, and Marketing, so those functions build roadmap, positioning, and regulatory strategy around real account behavior rather than assumption. The person in this seat reports to the Vice President of Sales, North America and acts as the connective tissue between account-level reality and company-level decisions.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

Segment Blueprint Creation

Build and own segment-specific blueprints (CPO & Retail) that document customer economics, procurement patterns, technical/product requirements, and competitive positioning within each segment

Translate blueprint findings into structured inputs for four functions: Product (feature and roadmap priorities), Policy (regulatory and incentive positioning), R&D (technical requirements), and Marketing (positioning and messaging). Own this as a standing feedback loop with defined cadence, not a one-time handoff

Generate new growth with major market movers within each sub-segment

Maintain and refresh blueprints against market, competitive, and policy shifts; define and track KPIs that indicate segment traction and blueprint accuracy

Strategic Account Management

Own relationships for a portfolio of top-tier public charging accounts; be the primary point of accountability for account health, growth, and retention

Lead negotiation and contract structuring for major, complex, multi-year agreements

Drive footprint expansion within key public charging accounts, deepening existing relationships to secure large, repeat business

Coordinate cross-functional pursuit teams (sales, marketing, legal, finance, product) on major RFPs and large bids, using blueprint data to sharpen proposal strategy

Cross-Functional Enablement

Act as the primary conduit from account and field intelligence into Product, Policy, R&D, and Marketing — accountable for ensuring blueprint insight measurably changes what gets built, priced, and messaged, not just that it gets reported

Provide business case analysis, financial modeling, and ROI assessments to support major pursuits and investment decisions

Track performance of segment strategies against plan; adjust blueprints and account plans as the market evolves

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field; MBA a plus

10–15 years of experience in business development, strategic account management, or strategic planning, with at least 5 years managing multi-regional field sales teams; EV, energy, or technology sector background required, with public charging market exposure strongly preferred

Skilled at building executive-ready presentations (PowerPoint) that translate complex data into clear narratives for internal and external stakeholder

Comfortable leveraging AI and automation tools to accelerate research, analysis, and content development

Strong analytical and financial modeling skills

Track record of building and managing top-tier commercial relationships, and of translating account-level insight into cross-functional influence with Product, Policy, R&D, and Marketing

Ability to think strategically and act operationally — able to convert high-level goals into segment blueprints and account plans that other functions can act on directly

Proficiency in market research, data analysis, and presenting findings to internal stakeholders and leadership

In-depth understanding of the e-mobility industry, public charging infrastructure, and energy markets highly preferred

Willingness to travel domestically as business needs require

Location

Atlanta, Los Angeles, Campbell, Phoenix

We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager – Foundation Pillar

Team: Product Marketing
Reports to: VP, Product Marketing

About the Role

6sense is the GTM Intelligence Platform, and Foundation is the layer the rest of it stands on — "platform, data, infrastructure: the backbone everything builds on." It owns account and people data, matching and identity, the APIs and MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and the workflows that move data through the system. When buyers ask whether 6sense is accurate, extensible, secure, and composable, the answer lives here.

We're looking for a Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager to own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for the Foundation pillar. This is the most technical seat on the PMM team. You'll translate deep capabilities — identity resolution, data coverage and accuracy, API extensibility, the MCP framework, security and compliance — into differentiated stories that win over the technical and economic buyers who scrutinize them: RevOps architects, IT and security teams, data leaders, and increasingly developers building agentic GTM stacks.

You'll also carry one of the most strategically important narratives in the company: that 6sense is a composable intelligence layer other systems and AI agents plug into — "AI to the data, not data to the AI" — rather than a closed destination. With the MCP framework moving to GA, this is a present-tense story, and you'll be the one who tells it credibly.

What You'll Own

Positioning and messaging for the Foundation pillar — platform, data, infrastructure, identity and matching, APIs and the MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and workflows. You set the narrative and keep it coherent with the Intelligence and Activation pillars.

Technical proof. Turn capability into credibility: architecture explainers, technical briefs and whitepapers, benchmarks, and reference narratives that substantiate the "backbone everything builds on" claim — especially around data accuracy, coverage, and identity resolution.

The composable / MCP-agent story. Own the infrastructure-layer narrative — 6sense as the data and intelligence layer that agentic GTM stacks compose with. Lead GTM for the MCP framework and the developer / technical-buyer audience it opens up.

Differentiation for the data and identity layer. Make the case against point data providers and infrastructure alternatives — coverage, match rates, identity quality, enrichment, security posture — and arm the field to win on it.

Field and partner enablement for technical evaluations. Build the battlecards, objection handling, FAQs, and solution content that win RFPs, security reviews, and technical POCs. Partner with Sales Engineering to make the technical buyer's diligence a place 6sense wins.

Launches. Drive end-to-end GTM for Foundation releases: new data assets, API and MCP capabilities, security packages (SCIM, SSO role mapping, audit, custom roles), connectors, and workflow features.

Cross-functional partnership. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Foundation Product and Engineering leaders to shape roadmap-to-market, and with Customer Success to surface the post-sale and admin/security use cases that prove the platform's breadth.

Market and competitive intelligence for the data and platform layer, feeding insight back into roadmap and pricing/packaging conversations.

What You'll Bring

8+ years in product marketing, technical product management, or a closely related function, with substantial technical PMM experience for platform, data, infrastructure, API, or developer products.

A proven ability to translate technical concepts — APIs, data pipelines, identity resolution, integrations, security, and AI/agent architectures like MCP — into crisp positioning and business value, without losing the engineers in the room or the buyers outside it.

A track record owning messaging for technical products and enabling technical sales motions (Sales Engineering, RFPs, security reviews, POCs).

Hands-on, not hand-wavy. You'll personally call the APIs, stand up and configure the MCP server, connect it to an agent, and build the demo — and your messaging is sharper because you've done the thing, not just read the spec.

Strong writing — you can produce content that is technically rigorous and genuinely clear, from a one-line value prop to an architecture whitepaper.

Fluency with the B2B SaaS buyer, ideally in martech, RevTech, or data platforms, and comfort selling to technical and economic buyers (RevOps architects, IT, security, data teams, developers).

The judgment and presence to operate as a senior individual contributor: set strategy, lead cross-functionally without authority, and influence product and executive stakeholders.

Nice to Have

Hands-on familiarity with data enrichment and identity (waterfall enrichment, matching, intent data), MCP and agentic AI architectures, or composable/API-first platforms.

Experience marketing to developers or technical evaluators, including documentation-adjacent and developer-community work.

Background in or adjacent to GTM intelligence, ABM, sales intelligence, CDP, iPaaS, or identity platforms.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, Foundation has a differentiated, defensible position that technical buyers recognize; the composable/MCP infrastructure story is landed with the field and the market as something that exists today, not a roadmap promise; the data and identity credibility story is substantiated with proof, not assertion; and the field has the enablement to win the technical evaluation every time it comes.

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place

Your Team and Role

Working on the Marketing & Communications Functional Team, you'll drive profitable acquisition of paid subscribers and work on related projects that aim to help millions of people take back control of their personal information.

Recent projects include:

Supporting strategy and planning for new paid advertising initiatives to profitably scale subscriptions

Launching new ad channel tests and measuring incremental lift

Executing in-market tests for new creative and messaging following a brand refresh

As a Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll manage high priority marketing campaigns, including planning, hands-on execution, testing, optimization, and analysis to optimize spend and drive profitable paid subscriber growth. This role will help create and execute a new marketing program for paid subscriptions. You'll deliver results from new channel testing, creative testing, and by optimizing paid subscriber conversion. The right person is excited to prove that paid marketing growth and privacy-respecting advertising practices aren’t at odds — they’re our edge. You know how to use aggregate measurement, experimentation, and strong judgment rather than user-level targeting and tracking.

About You

7+ years of experience in digital advertising roles, with 2+ years of experience in paid acquisition for freemium consumer subscription apps preferred.

Demonstrated experience with both strategic planning and execution in digital marketing platforms (app store ads, paid social, mobile app networks) to profitably scale app subscriber growth.

Hands-on expertise standing up paid subscription programs from scratch, with a track record of scaling subscriber growth profitably against LTV and payback — not just acquisition costs.

Experience driving subscription growth within an established, high-traffic product where subscription revenue is a secondary — not primary — revenue model, preferred.

Track record partnering with Engineering and Product to build and optimize landing pages, funnels, product experiences, and instrumentation.

Ability to execute highly complex and ambiguous projects, working across business strategy and marketing tactics.

Advanced analytical and measurement abilities, including app economics (payback, LTV), incrementality/lift testing, modeling, and data analysis.

Excellent communication skills — you can clearly articulate recommendations and rationale, whether verbal or written.

Qualifications

8+ years of SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals.

Experience selling to procurement, finance, legal, IT, operations, supply chain, or manufacturing teams.

Proven success acquiring net-new logos in organizations with 10,000+ employees.

Skilled in complex sales cycles: Managing multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement processes, and driving consensus at the executive level.

Self-motivated and proactive: You take ownership of your success and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Exceptional communication and organization skills to manage multiple opportunities effectively.

Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

We're hiring multiple Senior Product Managers across teams as we continue to scale.

We run small, cross-functional squads that own a real slice of the business, from prepaid cards to core platform to special projects. We'll match you to the squad that fits your interests and where you'll have the most impact.

Today, the product management org is seven PMs, led by a co-founder who serves as Head of Product.

What you’ll do

Own your team's roadmap. Work with stakeholders to figure out what to build and when. When the path isn't obvious, your job is to create clarity.

Do the research. User interviews, market analysis, competitive teardowns, data digs. Whatever it takes to back up your thinking.

Move quickly using AI. Use AI agents to dig through customer tickets, sales calls, usage data, and competitor research. Use prototypes to illustrate approaches.

Partner with design and engineering through the build. Designers refine the UX, engineers estimate and build, you unblock and keep scope honest.

Work async. Most product work here happens in writing. If you're used to running product through meetings, this will feel different.

Drive decisions without bulldozing. People won't always agree on priorities. It's your job to land decisions while keeping people bought in.

Close the loop. After we ship, help the team understand the impact.

What you’ll bring

6+ years building and shipping web applications as a designer, engineer, or product manager at tech companies.

2+ years as a PM at a growth-stage startup.

Strong product intuition. You can look at a product problem and see the right solution.

Strong design judgment and technical fluency. You hold your own with designers and engineers.

A track record of turning long-term strategy and a backlog of ideas into a prioritized, shovel-ready roadmap.

Strong written and verbal communication. We're documentation-first, so you'll spend a lot of time writing.

Comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, and pushing work forward without being told to.

Genuine empathy for users and teammates. You want to understand their problems.

What's cool about the role

Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $225,000 to $300,000

Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.

Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.

Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 

Job Summary

As a Business Systems Engineer on the GTM Engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's Go-To-Market business — spanning core business products and the integration platforms that connect them. This role is AI-native at its core: you won't just maintain existing workflows, you'll actively advance our GTM systems with intelligent agents, LLM-powered automations, and next-generation integration patterns built on MCP, ClickUp Super Agents, and modern iPaaS tooling.

You'll sit at the intersection of business systems architecture and applied AI — partnering with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and fellow GTM Systems engineers to eliminate toil, accelerate revenue workflows, and build the automated, AI-augmented infrastructure the company runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone deeply fluent in enterprise business systems, excited about deploying production AI, and committed to genuine ownership of the platforms they build — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Native Automation & Agent Development

Design and build AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across the GTM tech stack — including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, and MuleSoft — to eliminate manual effort and accelerate business operations.

Develop and deploy ClickUp Super Agents and LLM-based automations to automate tasks such as deal data enrichment, quote generation assistance, order validation, revenue recognition triggers, and exception handling in quote-to-cash workflows.

Architect and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that allow AI agents to interact with business systems contextually and safely — enabling intelligent, event-driven actions across the GTM platform.

Explore and evaluate emerging AI capabilities (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration) and determine which are production-ready for GTM business systems use cases.

Build reusable AI templates, automation patterns, and agent blueprints that can be extended across the GTM Engineering team.

Business Systems Integration & Architecture

Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design.

Own end-to-end integration patterns for critical business flows such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, order-to-fulfillment, and revenue reporting pipelines.

Design data flows and transformation logic that keep business data accurate, consistent, and accessible across systems without creating fragile point-to-point dependencies.

Apply a build-vs-buy mindset: evaluate whether a given automation need is best solved with native platform capabilities, iPaaS tooling, or custom code — and make the case clearly.

Platform Development & Tooling

Build internal tooling, low-code/no-code solutions, and lightweight applications using platforms such as Retool, Replit, or similar to extend business systems capabilities with minimal overhead.

Write automation scripts and data transformation logic in Python, JavaScript, or Apex as needed to bridge gaps that platform tooling cannot address natively.

Utilize Zapier, Workato, and similar iPaaS platforms to orchestrate cross-system workflows that are maintainable, observable, and well-documented.

Own the full lifecycle of what you build: discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

Reliability, Observability & Continuous Improvement

Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations.

Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches.

Maintain runbooks and operational documentation so that platform behavior is understandable and recoverable by the broader team.

Gather feedback from business stakeholders and iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce edge cases, and adapt to evolving GTM processes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.

Work closely with GTM Systems Engineering, DevOps, and BSA teammates on architecture decisions, intake prioritization, and delivery execution.

Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene, communicate proactively on large initiatives, and log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry.

Serve as a subject matter expert for business systems automation and AI — educating stakeholders on what's possible and setting realistic expectations on scope and delivery.

Qualifications

Experience

3–5+ years in a business systems engineering, systems administration, or integration engineering role.

Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments.

Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one ERP platform (NetSuite strongly preferred).

Experience deploying AI or LLM-powered automations in a production business systems context — or a clear, demonstrated trajectory toward it.

Experience working in a high-velocity environment where you manage multiple concurrent priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs.

Optional but valued: experience with DealHub (CPQ), ClickUp, quote-to-cash workflows, or revenue operations systems.

Skills & Competencies

Technical

Salesforce configuration, automation (Flow, Process Builder), Apex, and data model design — admin or developer-level proficiency required.

NetSuite workflows, SuiteScript, SuiteBundler, saved searches, and data model — particularly as it relates to order management, billing, and revenue recognition.

Hands-on experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS platforms — including multi-step flows, error handling, and observability.

Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, and MCP integrations. Experience with ClickUp Super Agents is a strong plus.

Proficient with Python, JavaScript, or Apex for automation scripting and data transformation; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth-based integrations.

Strong understanding of business systems data models and integration patterns (event-driven, batch, real-time).

Operational & Mindset

Ownership: You take full responsibility for the systems you build — from reliability and documentation to stakeholder trust and continuous improvement. You don't hand off and walk away.

Velocity: You move fast, iterate, and ship. You know when "good enough and deployed" beats "perfect and blocked," and you never sacrifice reliability or data integrity to get there.

AI & Automation mindset: You default to asking "how can an agent or LLM handle this?" before reaching for a manual workflow — experimenting confidently and evaluating critically.

Collaboration: You bridge the gap between technical architecture and business impact, asking clarifying questions, challenging assumptions respectfully, and earning trust with the stakeholders you support.

Growth: You stay current on emerging AI capabilities, evaluate what's production-ready, and continuously raise the bar on what GTM systems can do.

What You'll Work With

Salesforce: CRM platform — automations, Flow, Apex, data model, reporting, and CPQ/OTC integrations.

NetSuite: ERP platform — SuiteScript, workflows, order management, billing, and revenue recognition flows.

ClickUp Super Agents: AI-powered automation and agentic task orchestration within the ClickUp ecosystem.

Integration stack: Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier — recipe/flow development, cross-system orchestration, and platform observability.

AI & MCP tooling: LLM APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflow design, and production AI integration patterns.

Low-code tooling: Retool, Replit, or similar for internal applications and workflow extensions.

Scripting & APIs: Python, JavaScript, Apex, REST/webhook integrations, and JSON-based data transformation.

Equal Opportunity Employer 

ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Privacy Notice

ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

If you are a Philippine Job Applicant, please also see our Philippine Data Privacy Notice for further details.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

We will never request fees, payments, or sensitive personal information. Please disregard any offers received outside these channels and report them to support@clickup.com.

jobs.description:
About Chili Piper

Chili Piper is a B2B SaaS company that helps GTM teams turn inbound leads into qualified meetings - instantly. Our Demand Conversion Platform makes it easier for buyers and sellers to connect fast, without the usual friction in the funnel.

We’re a fully remote, global team that loves building solutions that truly help our customers, moving fast, and having fun while creating something meaningful. We’re growing quickly and aiming big!

***CURRENTLY ONLY HIRING FOR THIS ROLE IN CANADA AND THE US***

About the role

At Chili Piper, community and events are at the heart of our GTM strategy. From intimate dinners to large-scale activations like our annual ChiliPalooza, we bring top GTM leaders together to connect, exchange ideas, and build lasting relationships. It's how we turn a room full of people into real pipeline, and how we've built a community that actually wants to hear from us.

We're hiring an Events Manager to scale these experiences and deepen our relationships with the GTM community: executive dinners, industry conferences, sponsorships, speaking moments, webinars, and ChiliPalooza. This is the person who turns our presence in a room, physical or virtual, into brand awareness, pipeline, and lasting relationships.

This role is part of our marketing team and works cross-functionally with Sales and Partnerships to run Chili Piper's global event strategy. You'll have real ownership of the calendar and where we show up, not just the execution. You'll shape the annual plan, then make it happen: logistics, promotion, on-site, and follow-up, all the way through to measurable impact.

This is a hands-on role. You're the one building the landing pages, pulling the CRM lists, and running the show on-site, not handing a brief to an agency and waiting. It's a strong fit for someone who is organized and proactive, thinks creatively about how we show up, and brings original ideas and a sense of humor to every event. It's fully remote, with travel to events as needed.

What you'll do

Own the annual event calendar. Decide, with marketing leadership, where Chili Piper should have a presence and why, and protect that focus as new opportunities come up

Bring original ideas, creativity, and humor to how we show up, so our events feel like Chili Piper and not like everyone else's

Manage execution end to end. Logistics, budgets, venues, vendors, shipments, swag, and on-site coordination, done by you and tracked by you

Run event promotion from start to finish. Build event and webinar landing pages, export and segment contact lists from Salesforce and HubSpot to target the right attendees by city or segment, and send invites, reminders, and follow-ups independently

Produce our virtual events and webinars end to end, from speaker prep and rehearsal to running the live show

Collaborate across teams. With Marketing on branding, design, and promotion; with Sales to identify and invite the right prospects and customers; with Partnerships to coordinate sponsors and activations

Ensure smooth on-site execution. Keep schedules on track and deliver a seamless experience from load-in to last handshake

Build and nurture community. Deepen our relationships with GTM leaders, partners, and community members so our events compound over time

Track performance. Collect attendee data, measure engagement, and report on outcomes and pipeline impact

Amplify results. Work with Marketing to repurpose event content, including photos, videos, and testimonials, for social and post-event communication

Manage vendors and budgets. Source partners, negotiate rates, and keep quality high and costs in check

Run the debrief on every event and turn what you learn into a stronger program next time

What we're looking for

Builder mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you how, you figure it out

Tech-savvy operator. You know your way around CRM exports, spreadsheets, event tools, and email automation

Hands-on doer. You do the execution and track the results yourself

Creative problem-solver. When a venue cancels or a vendor flakes, you find a workaround fast, and when the format is stale, you invent a better one

Organized and proactive. You turn chaos into systems and think two steps ahead

Strong communicator. You coordinate cross-functional teams, vendors, and execs smoothly

Customer-first. You care about memorable, frictionless experiences from invite to post-event follow-up

Curious and eager to learn. You're always exploring new tools, trends, and ideas, including AI, to make each event better than the last

Experience

2+ years in event management, field marketing, or community roles, ideally in B2B SaaS

Proven ability to plan and execute events, from small dinners to large activations

Hands-on experience with CRM tools like Salesforce and HubSpot, and event platforms like Luma, Zoom Webinars or similar

Comfortable building simple landing pages, managing email lists, and running event promotion campaigns

Skilled in vendor sourcing, budget tracking, and on-site coordination

Strong cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships

Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and manage shifting priorities

Familiar with tracking and reporting event performance, including attendance, engagement, and pipeline impact

Experience managing partner collaborations or maintaining relationships with GTM leaders and communities is a plus

Nice to have

Experience in B2B SaaS, RevOps, or MarTech

Prior involvement in partner activations or co-marketing events

Experience managing sponsorships or collaborations with other brands

Comfortable using analytics tools to measure event outcomes

A strong network within the GTM, Sales, or Marketing communities

Background in social or content amplification around events, for example capturing and repurposing event moments

Interview process

Application review. We'll review your background and experience to make sure there's a good fit for the role.

Culture add interview. A first chat to get to know you: what drives you, how you like to work, and what unique perspective you'd bring to Chili Piper.

Assessment. A short, practical assignment to see how you think and approach a real events challenge. It's not a test, we just want to see your creativity and thought process.

Executive interview. The final step. We'll talk about your bigger picture, your passion for the space, your understanding of our product, and why Chili Piper feels like the right next step for you.

TL;DR

We're not hiring a "planner." We're hiring someone who can own the full experience, from the CRM export to the on-site execution to the community that keeps growing after everyone goes home, and turn GTM moments into momentum and measurable results.

If that sounds like you, we want to talk.

Additional Information

Why you'll love being a part of our team:

Our team loves Chili Piper because we’re building the company of the future. 

Work with an immensely talented global team

Work in a business that’s run fairly and transparently

Competitive pay based on market rate wherever you live

We lead by example--showing industry peers and leaders how to innovate, improve, and grow--while having fun

How we work:

Freedom and flexibility. We’re a 100% distributed team working from around the world, and we've been fully remote since 2016. Our team members can work from wherever they want in the world, as long as they show up on our weekly all hands meeting on Zoom.

Solve interesting problems. The software landscape has exploded. There are dozens of solutions for each problem. We want to be different. We come up with new angles on existing problems or invent better solutions to help companies with their sales and marketing. Then we turn these ideas into beautiful, smart software.

Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.

Be helpful. Our first value as a company is help. Help our customers be successful. Help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our products. Help our team members reach their full potential.

The perks:

Unlimited vacation (and we do mean it, and we do take it!)

Generous health, dental, and vision insurance

Any equipment/software/tech that you need to do your job

Annual professional development stipend of $2,000 USD

Equity - all Pipers receive stock options

Annual company retreat in epic locations (past trips: Paris, Morocco, Tulum, Iceland, Ibiza, India). Check out the video from last year’s retreat in Tenerife.

Senior/Staff Machine Learning Data Scientist

In Brief

We’re an early-stage startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.

TLDR: Independent end-to-end model development with ability to work cross-functionally with Clinical, Engineering, and Product to clarify and prioritize specifications and features for our life-saving AI models.

Who We Are

Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.

Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved.

What you’ll do

As a Senior/Staff Machine Learning Data Scientist, you are not satisfied with training and tuning ML models that predict clinical conditions in patients; you also want to own the effectiveness of your model in the real world. In practice, that means you aren’t afraid to get your hands dirty by writing data mapping code, debugging a specific patient case by following patient data as it moves through our AWS services, or improving the timeliness of your model’s predictions by reading and writing production-grade Python and SQL code.

Responsibilities

Model Prototyping: Develop and tune innovative, new ML models and labeler systems based on deep understanding of clinical use cases and state-of-the-art ML methods

Productionizing: The same models that you develop with production-grade Python

Deploying: Identify strategies for improving our production ML-based systems, and write, debug, and deploy production-grade Python code to implement those strategies

Cross-Functional Alignment: Data Science for storytelling – understand model performance and metrics, and present this to technical and non-technical users, both internally and externally

Minimum qualifications

Ph.D. in a relevant field plus 3+ years experience shipping ML based software products

Experience owning your ML models from prototyping to production, especially real-time algorithms that update dynamically across time

Experience writing production-grade Python and SQL code to implement and evaluate ML models in production systems

Track record of using statistics and performance metrics to compare end-to-end ML and product performance

Preferred qualifications

Experience shipping breakthrough or 0-1 products from end to end, interpreting and leveraging State-of-the-Art methods to do so

Experience using messy clinical and health data to design new products for large Health Systems

Experience with any of the following: PyTorch, PySpark, HL7, FHIR, EHR, time series data, signal processing, MLFlow, anomaly detection, Bayesian statistics, quantile regression, time-series forecasting

You bring passion and enthusiasm to your work, and are excited to join a growing team to Get Stuff Done and save lives!

Who We Are

Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. Working directly with our health system clients' technical teams, you'll turn fragmented data into immediate, actionable clinical insights that empower care teams to make the best decisions for their patients.

Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a lab result isn't reaching the Bayesian platform for a patient, you have thirty minutes and the client's full attention to trace it from the inbound HL7 message through parsing, mapping, and ingestion, and tell them what happened.

Data Integration & Ingestion: Partner with the client's technical teams to design and implement the data integration interface and ingestion pipelines that feed the Bayesian platform with real-time clinical data, powering insights that improve patient outcomes.

Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests at the data layer, and work directly with client technical teams during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations.

Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring build and configuration for the data interface, ingestion, and mapping are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any data integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication.

Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the data integration workstream with the overall integration effort.

Minimum qualifications

BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

3+ years building and deploying data pipelines to production, including integration with external APIs (Python preferred)

Strong ability to investigate and resolve data correctness problem end-to-end, across services, storage, and external data sources.

Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment

Experience writing automated integration tests for production systems

Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Project/Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results.

Preferred qualifications

Experience with health data, integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems, and Health IT interoperability standards such as HL7v2 and FHIR.

Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues

Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require.
